scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Tour out/tour-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --muted --crf=16 && npm run finish
scripts.render:promo: remotion render src/index.ts Promo out/promo-raw.mp4 --codec=h264 --muted --crf=16 --concurrency=100% && npm run voice:promo && npm run music:promo && npm run finish:promo
scripts.finish: remotion ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/tour-raw.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -movflags +faststart -an ../output/teacher-tour.mp4
